definition: a wide round bowl you fill with water for washing
description: A big white enamel basin stands on a wooden stool in a garden and everything happens over it: a woman leans her head down into it, her friend washes her hair above the water, the soapy water collects inside, and at the end a can of clean water is poured over her hair back into the basin.

de.answer: Sie schäumt ihrer Freundin die Haare ein.

es.answer: Está enjabonando el pelo de su amiga.
